project_type: Monorepo: Django 5.2.18 + DRF 3.18.3 backend on MongoDB (django_mongodb_backend 5.2.x, needs a replica set for transactions) in backend/; Python click CLI `vaultshield` in cli/; React 19 + Tailwind 4.3.3 dashboard (Vite, Jest) in frontend/
build_system: pip editable installs in existing venvs backend/.venv and cli/.venv (already set up; do not recreate). frontend uses npm; frontend/node_modules does NOT exist yet -> run `cd frontend && npm ci` once (lockfile-pinned, node_modules/ is git-ignored).
test_framework: pytest + pytest-django (backend), pytest + hypothesis + click CliRunner (cli), Jest 30 + @testing-library/react + jest-environment-jsdom (frontend)
build_command: backend: `cd backend && .venv/bin/python manage.py check` (needs VAULTSHIELD_MONGODB_URL exported and reachable Mongo); frontend: `cd frontend && npm run build` (optional)
test_command: backend full: `cd backend && .venv/bin/pytest -q` with VAULTSHIELD_MONGODB_URL and VAULTSHIELD_TEST_MONGODB_URL exported to the replica set; backend DB-free: `cd backend && VAULTSHIELD_MONGODB_URL=mongodb://localhost:1/vaultshield .venv/bin/pytest -q runs/tests.py`; cli: `cd cli && .venv/bin/pytest -q`; frontend: `cd frontend && CI=true npm test -- --ci`
verification_instructions: 1) Start Docker Desktop if `docker info` fails (`open -a Docker`, poll `docker info` up to ~2 min). 2) Replica set on port 27018 (27017 may be held by an unrelated auto-started ipsakti-mongo container; never stop/modify ipsakti-* containers): `docker run -d --rm --name vs-test-mongo -p 27018:27017 mongo:7 --replSet rs0 --bind_ip_all`; `docker exec vs-test-mongo mongosh --quiet --eval 'rs.initiate({_id:"rs0",members:[{_id:0,host:"localhost:27017"}]})'`; poll `docker exec vs-test-mongo mongosh --quiet --eval 'rs.status().myState'` until it prints 1; `export VAULTSHIELD_MONGODB_URL='mongodb://localhost:27018/vaultshield?directConnection=true'; export VAULTSHIELD_TEST_MONGODB_URL="$VAULTSHIELD_MONGODB_URL"`. If the container already exists from an earlier step, reuse it. 3) Backend: `makemigrations --check --dry-run` (expect 'No changes detected'), `manage.py check`, full `pytest -q`. 4) CLI full `pytest -q`; note Docker-gated skips in tests/test_sandbox_execution.py (also need image vaultshield-sandbox:local) by name. 5) Frontend `npm ci` then `CI=true npm test -- --ci`. 6) The final step stops vs-test-mongo. If no replica set can be started: hand-write migration 0002 per design §4.1 with header `# Generated by Django 5.2.18 on <date>`, run only DB-free tests, and report makemigrations/check/acceptance 1/all test_mongodb.py tests as NOT RUN with the reason.
snapshot_or_generated_files: backend/runs/migrations/0002_alter_run_status.py is generated by `cd backend && .venv/bin/python manage.py makemigrations runs` (needs the replica set) and must match the body pinned in batch2-design.md §4.1 from `from django.db import` onward. No other generated files.
environment_constraints: macOS zsh; no `timeout` binary. Planning-time baselines: cli full 662 passed / 22 skipped; backend runs/tests.py (DB-free) 64 passed. Docker API returned HTTP 500 at planning time (Docker Desktop down). `python3` is 3.14 — always use the venv interpreters. key_patterns: Backend: `apply_decision` in backend/runs/views.py:129-255 = retry_on_transient_transaction_error(fn) + django_mongodb_backend.transaction.atomic() + conditional Run.objects.filter(pk=..., status__in=ALLOWED).update(status=..., updated_at=to_mongo_precision(now)); zero rows -> StateTransitionError(_stored_status_of(run)) (409 {detail, current_status}). RunViewSet has no partial_update/perform_create overrides today; get_serializer_class maps partial_update -> RunUpdateSerializer; PUT excluded via http_method_names. CLI: cli.py imports `uploader` as a module and calls uploader.<fn> (so tests monkeypatch module attributes); uploader one-shot httpx style in _request_token, `_post` catches (httpx.HTTPError, httpx.InvalidURL), helpers _build_url/_auth_headers/_error_detail, validate_run_id from run_directory wrapped into UploadError; tests/test_uploader.py uses a ThreadingHTTPServer `_IngestHandler`; tests/test_cli.py `_wire_run_pipeline` (~:332-352) stubs load_token/upload_run/docker.from_env and records into `calls`; tests/test_interactive_auth.py `_wire` + `_FakeInteractiveExec` (timed_out attr). Frontend: RunHistoryView.jsx STATUS_STYLES (5 keys) + UNKNOWN_STATUS_STYLE slate; RunStatusBadge renders data-status; RunDetailView.jsx DECIDABLE_STATUS='awaiting_review', exported DecisionControls with 'Approve'/'Reject' buttons.
